prompt: Discover and package one reusable Skill for RDKit RECAP terminal molecular fragments using RecapDecompose and GetLeaves. Ground the usage, input/output scope, terminal versus full hierarchy interpretation and valid empty results in the provided source. This is molecular fragmentation, not descriptor calculation. Choose appropriate delivery files and document prerequisites and invalid input boundaries. Do not install software or run source/business code on the host; business execution is permitted only in a Docker container. Do not claim chemical or scientific validation beyond the documented algorithm.
notes: Operator-authorised envelope for the current debugging rounds: up to 16 admitted model calls per round, 600 s per call, 3600 s per round, no fallback, no probe outside the budget, no restart or resume of a failed round. repair_rounds=2 allows three author/review candidates because the independent review keeps finding real source-accuracy defects in the documentation; the call budget still caps the round. Native discovery/author/review use Codex CLI turns (model.backend=codex_cli, model.name=gpt-6-astra) with tools and resume, transport=https, reasoning_effort=medium and service_tier=default. Structured association/planning/diagnosis remain on the DeepSeek API with api_retries=1 (one model-request retry after a transport failure) and api_connect_retries=1 (a connection that never opened cannot have reached the model). pin_base_image=true resolves and freezes the base digest.
